summaries.summary: The U.S. cancels the G20 family photo due to objections from European countries about the inclusion of Russia's minister, Lavrov.
Apple is addressing screen cracking issues with its new iPhone Duo, responding to reports from users who experienced problems shortly after purchase.
Salesforce continues its acquisition efforts with a $375 million deal for defense tech startup Rune, enhancing its Missionforce defense platform.
ISRO successfully launched the NVS-03 satellite, restoring the NavIC constellation and overcoming previous technical challenges.
The Supreme Court directs the Election Commission to investigate allegations of misuse regarding bulk voter list deletions in Uttar Pradesh.
The escape of prisoners from Tamil Nadu's Theni jail has raised concerns about security protocols and resulted in administrative repercussions.
November 6 marks the opening of the 12th Google Store, expanding access to Google's products.
The Census 2027 will commence door-to-door enumeration starting January 25, 2027, emphasizing adjustments for poll-bound and snow-hit areas.
The Galaxy S27 Ultra chipset developments indicate ongoing debates and updates on its features and specifications.
